subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the glossy red crab in <Picture 1>, with two asymmetrical bulging eye stalks (the left eye far larger), a wide grin of square white teeth, a bumpy red shell, and two large pincers; in the first frame he is frozen inside a clear ice block.
<Subject 2> is the towering shaggy white snowman creature in <Picture 2>, fully draped in long matted white fur with a dark nose and tiny eyes; he stands at roughly the same towering height as <Subject 3>, so the two read as equal-sized peers; his throwing arm, hand, and foot appear first, then his full body in the final shot.
<Subject 3> is the gaunt pale old mage in <Picture 3>, with a huge round belly, tattered loincloth and leg wrappings, holding a tall twisted wooden staff with a hooked head.
<Subject 4> is the frozen alien valley in <Picture 4>, with wind-carved ice monoliths whose high arches cradle glowing heart-shaped gems and snow fields; its sky remains the dark crimson storm established in the previous scenes.
<Picture 5> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a low angle beside the clear ice block containing the frozen <Subject 1>, with <Subject 3>'s lower body and staff at the left and a blue-gem monolith in the right background under the crimson sky.
summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] A 15-second stylized 3D slapstick finale opening exactly on <Picture 5>: while <Subject 3> charges his raised staff, a frozen boulder hurled by <Subject 2> smacks the mage flying; <Subject 2> then seizes him by the neck, stuffs the red Heart of the Deep into his mouth, and volley-kicks him skyward like a football; the mage rockets up and bursts into a chain of successive red fireworks; <Subject 2> frees <Subject 1>, and the two walk off into the distance while only fading embers drift in the sky.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - the asymmetrical googly eye stalks, red shell, and pincers are retained; the mage's charge is interrupted before any swing, so the ice block stays untouched until it is released.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - the shaggy white-fur silhouette is retained at the same towering height as <Subject 3>; he throws the boulder, then performs the grab-stuff-kick.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the gaunt pale head, round belly, tattered wrappings, and hooked staff are retained; his burst into chained fireworks is a plot transformation.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 4], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - the monoliths, gem arches, snow fields, and crimson sky are retained.
<Picture 5> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the low-angle blocking of ice block with frozen crab, mage's lower body at left, and blue monolith at right is retained.
detailed_description:
The target video is a stylized 3D animated slapstick finale short with painterly textures, cinematic camera work, and exaggerated cartoon physics, under the crimson storm sky.
[Shot 1]  a low angle beside the clear ice block containing the frozen <Subject 1>, with <Subject 3>'s lower body and staff at the left and a blue-gem monolith in the right background. The camera tilts up to <Subject 3>'s snarling face as he raises the staff high with both hands and says, [English] You ruined my plan! You will pay the price! Wind and snow swirl and converge into the staff's hooked head, the ground trembles and the frame shudders, and the staff's glow intensifies as the charge builds - before any swing begins, the shot cuts.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot: while <Subject 3> still holds the staff high in his charge, a jagged frozen boulder - hurled by <Subject 2>, whose furry throwing arm shows in follow-through at the frame's left edge - streaks in from off-screen left trailing white vapor and smacks <Subject 3> square in the chest with a heavy crack; the mage is knocked flying backward, his staff spinning out of his grip, and he lands in a heap at <Subject 2>'s planted feet.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot: the towering shaggy snowman <Subject 2>, at the same height as the mage, reaches down, seizes <Subject 3> by the neck, and hoists him up; in one crisp beat the hand stuffs the red Heart of the Deep into the mage's open mouth with a loud gulp, then tosses him a half-body upward and swings the right leg in a huge football-style volley kick - torso leaning back, leg cocked then whipped fully through the contact in a long follow-through arc, a shockwave ring of snow bursting at the impact point with a cannon-like BOOM - launching <Subject 3> skyward like a struck ball.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a wide low angle tracking upward: <Subject 3> rockets into the sky with a high fading scream, crimson light spreading from his belly across his whole body; at the apex his body bursts into the first red firework bloom, immediately followed by a chain of three more successive blooms popping one after another across the crimson sky, each with a soft crackle, scattering sparkling red petals.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot at ground level: <Subject 2> crouches beside the ice block and taps it gently with one finger; the block cracks and <Subject 1> pops out free with a comedic pop, shaking ice shards off his shell; the crab scrambles up and hops onto <Subject 2>'s broad shoulder, raising one pincer in a tiny triumphant wave.
[Shot 6] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a wide serene shot: <Subject 2> lumbers away into the distance with a gentle swaying gait, <Subject 1> standing proud on his shoulder; overhead only the last fireworks fade into slowly drifting embers and a soft red afterglow, with no new explosions; snowflakes drift gently, and the two silhouettes recede like old friends as the scene holds and softly fades.
overall_soundscape:
Roaring wind convergence and a ground tremor under the raised staff, a flying-boulder whoosh and a heavy impact crack, a staff clatter, a loud gulp, a cannon-like kick BOOM with a shockwave whoosh, a high fading scream, a chain of successive firework crackles, a comedic ice pop, slow heavy friendly footsteps, and a gentle snowfall hush at the end.
non_diegetic_music:
A dark rising sting under the verdict, percussive hits synced to the boulder impact and the grab-stuff-kick, a soaring comedic rocket glissando that blooms into a warm orchestral swell with successive pop accents for the chained fireworks, then a soft gentle music-box and strings lullaby under the final walk-off, ending on a single warm sustained chord.
